verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS FP&A platform like Aleph, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Encryption, access permissions, audit logs, and removing data after a trial are adjacent privacy features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
